full_judgment: "It may also be remembered that this power is vested not in minor officials but in top ranking authorities like the Commissioner of Income Tax and the Central Board of Revenue who act on the information supplied to them by the Income Tax Officer concerned. This power is discretionary and not necessarily discriminatory and abuse of power cannot be easily assumed where the discretion is vested in such high officials." "There is moreover a presumption that public officials will discharge their duties honestly and in accordance with the rules of law".
